What the columns mean

Select an issue to see its details.

Rules that raise many issues are listed first; click a column heading to sort by it. By default every rule is kept; tick Ignore only for rules your team does not want to be checked in this project, and give a short reason. Nothing changes until you download and send back your decisions.

These rules would be ignored for daav. Every ignored rule needs a reason.
